title: Authentication Specialist I - BLG
jobDescription:
About Entrupy
Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.
Entrupy’s solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy’s solutions in market:
● Entrupy Apparel Authentication
● Entrupy Bags & Leather Goods Authentication
● Entrupy Sneaker Authentication
● Entrupy Fingerprinting

As we continue to build...

We’re seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we’d love to have you apply.

About the Team/Role

Entrupy Inc. is seeking a full-time Authentication Specialist position based in Bangalore, India. The Authentication Specialist position is a salaried position. You will be trained to authenticate all of Entrupy’s supported brands through studying Entrupy’s microscopic data and intensive brand learning. You will be responsible for accurately assessing and tagging each item to assist in the machine learning process to further train our algorithms as well as meeting and exceeding SLAs through quality and efficient processing.
Reports to the Authentication Operations Manager
Location: Bangalore, India
Location Type: Hybrid

What you'll do

  • Monitor real­-time customer authentications of high-­end luxury goods
  • Ensure accuracies of internal tests pertaining to newly ­released brands and materials
  • Initiate follow­-up communication with customers on as­-needed basis

What you bring

  • Analytical skills and the ability to glean information and draw conclusions from large, often similar sets of data
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with your colleagues working remotely and in different timezones
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and closely follow procedure
  • Proficiency in working with software tools: e.g. Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, and other applications
  • Flexibility and openness to work on weekends, holidays, and outside of work hours
  • Prior experience with data entry, analytical or scientific research roles preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in Fashion Design or Fashion Technology from NIFT and NID is preferred

What we offer

  • Market competitive compensation structure
  • Hybrid with flexible work from anywhere for 8 weeks per year
  • Generous time away including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Rich medical benefits and insurance coverage

Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

title: Knowledge Analyst II, Bags & Leather Goods
location: Remote - Philippines, India, Hongkong, Japan, Dubai (UAE)
jobDescription:
About Entrupy
Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.
Entrupy’s solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy’s solutions in market:
● Entrupy Apparel Authentication
● Entrupy Bags & Leather Goods Authentication
● Entrupy Sneaker Authentication
● Entrupy Fingerprinting

As we continue to build...

We’re seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we’d love to have you apply.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Knowledge Analyst II with strong authentication expertise and a deep understanding of luxury handbags and leather goods. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on owning complex knowledge initiatives, improving authentication accuracy through structured data and insights, and helping evolve how Entrupy captures, analyses, and operationalises product intelligence.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Authentication, Training, Engineering, and Product teams, acting as both a subject matter expert and a strategic partner. This role requires high-level thinking, strong judgment, and the ability to lead projects from concept through execution.

Reports to: Knowledge Team Lead
Location: Remote -Philippines, India, Hong Kong, Japan, Dubai (United Arab Emirates)

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in luxury handbag and leather goods authentication, supporting high-impact authentication and training initiatives.
  • Make meaningful contributions to the development, evolution, and quality control of Entrupy’s knowledge systems, ensuring they are accurate, scalable, and aligned with business needs.
  • Analyse authentication trends, error patterns, and product data to identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Own and drive medium- to large-scale projects related to new brand and product support, knowledge structure, tooling, or content strategy, including defining scope, timelines, and success metrics.
  • Create advanced documentation, product intelligence frameworks, and reference materials that support expert-level decision-making.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to inform how knowledge is structured, tagged, and surfaced within Entrupy’s platforms.
  • Contribute to the design and refinement of training programs, helping raise the overall expertise of the global authentication team.
  • Stay ahead of market trends, brand updates, and emerging counterfeit techniques, translating insights into actionable knowledge assets.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to more junior Knowledge Analysts, supporting team growth and consistency.

What you bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in authentication, knowledge management, luxury goods research, fashion merchandising, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated expertise in authenticating luxury and contemporary handbags and leather goods, with strong brand-level knowledge.
  • Proven ability to think analytically about data, patterns, and systems, not just individual cases.
  • Experience leading projects or initiatives independently, with a track record of follow-through and impact.
  • Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear, usable resources.
  • High attention to detail paired with strong judgment and investigative instincts.
  • Comfort working with large visual datasets, structured documentation, and analytical tools (spreadsheets, tagging systems, internal platforms).
  • A collaborative mindset and confidence working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Deep interest in fashion, luxury, craftsmanship, and the role of authentication in protecting consumers and brands.


Culturally, we operate with intelligence, respect, and curiosity, relentlessly pursuing ideas to improve our offering and execute our mission.

We have had an incredible run so far and are laying the foundation for a culture that is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and rooted in passion, kindness, and positivity. We live by these values – we hire by them, promote them, and celebrate them every day.

If you are passionate about solving challenging problems in a diverse setup, we’d love to connect!

Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior HR Operations Specialist to support day-to-day HR operations for our Mangalore office.   • Support compliance-related documentation and HR administration.
  • Respond to employee questions related to HR processes, policies, and systems.
  • Maintain data accuracy across HR systems and support reporting needs.
  • Partner with local and global teams to ensure smooth HR operations and employee experience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.

  • Experience supporting onboarding, recruitment coordination, and employee lifecycle processes.

  • Strong communication skills and a service-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Reliable, proactive, and execution-focused.

  • A hands-on, mission-critical role with direct impact on how Entrupy operates and grows in India
  • The opportunity to be part of building something from the ground up — with the backing of a global team and leadership that is invested in getting it right

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly organized Senior People Operations Specialist to support global onboarding, offboarding, and core HR operations across multiple regions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building consistency, ensuring operational excellence, and working behind the scenes to create a seamless employee experience.

The ideal candidate is systems-oriented, thrives on accuracy, follows processes well, and takes pride in delivering high-quality operational support. This is not a strategic HR business partner role; it is a hands-on operations role focused on execution, coordination, compliance, and process excellence.

Location: Hybrid: Bangalore, Mangalore, India
Reports to: Lead, HR Operations

What you'll do

Global Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding processes for new hires across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Coordinate pre-boarding activities, documentation, system access, equipment requests, and onboarding communications.
  • Ensure a smooth and consistent onboarding experience for all employees.
  • Manage employee offboarding processes, including system deactivation, documentation, equipment recovery, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Maintain onboarding and offboarding checklists and continuously improve workflows.

Global HR Operations

  • Serve as a key operational resource for employee lifecycle processes, including hires, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, leaves of absence, and terminations.
  • Maintain accurate employee records across HR systems and ensure data integrity.
  • Execute recurring HR operational processes with a high degree of accuracy and timeliness.
  • Support audits, compliance requirements, and documentation requests.
  • Generate and maintain reports, trackers, and dashboards as needed.

HR Systems & Data Management

  • Act as a power user of HR systems and tools.
  • Perform data entry, audits, quality checks, and process validation activities.
  • Troubleshoot routine system-related issues and escalate when necessary.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, and improve operational processes.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate employee data across systems.

Employee Support

  • Respond to employee inquiries related to onboarding, offboarding, policies, systems, and HR processes.
  • Provide timely and professional support while ensuring a positive employee experience.
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining ownership through resolution.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 4–5 years of experience in HR Operations, People Operations, Shared Services, or HR Administration.
  • Experience supporting global employee populations is preferred.
  • Experience managing onboarding and offboarding processes at scale.

Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and coordination skills.
  • Comfortable following established processes while identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Strong systems aptitude and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • High degree of ownership, reliability, and follow-through.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with HRIS platforms such as Workday, Bamboo HR, Rippling, Hi Bob, or similar systems.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, and data validation tasks.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and workflow tools is a plus.

What we offer

  • A hands-on, mission-critical role with direct impact on how Entrupy operates and grows in India
  • The opportunity to be part of building something from the ground up — with the backing of a global team and leadership that is invested in getting it right
  • The chance to be part of a category-defining company at an inflection point in its growth

At Entrupy, we talk straight, think big, bring a growth mindset to everything we do, and make sure to embrace the fun along the way. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.

We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.
